description: This file defines a React-like component (using Qwik framework) for a sidebar filter UI in a job listings platform. It includes input fields for keyword, location, and job type, and handles user input to update filter state.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Defines a reactive Qwik component accepting props, rendering UI with filter controls.
Wraps a function for serialization in Qwik's resumability model.
